method: Fixed-context model baseline: all nine Sanity Knowledge Base entries supplied to every batch; no typed conditions, expected labels, or descriptive scenario names supplied. Retrieval selection is held constant.
limitations: Authored fixtures and Knowledge Base derived from the same curated pack. This measures agreement with the authored labels, not independent eligibility accuracy or a controlled RAG retrieval comparison.
